name: rasa.orchestrator.soccer.club
description: RasaOS Orchestrator · Soccer Club. Pattern 3 (Hybrid/CTO) club-operations platform managing the whole organization: members (players/parents), staff (coaches/directors/admins/board), teams, rosters, try-outs, age groups, genders, practice/game schedules, fields, complexes, tournaments, leagues, and multi-system registrations. Sits above the domain.soccer.* role family. First sub-namespaced orchestrator.

rasa.note: The FIRST sub-namespaced orchestrator, and a Pattern 3 (Hybrid/CTO-style) CLUB-OPERATIONS PLATFORM (orchestrator-core SHAPE.md Pattern 3 — 'a club with N teams' is the soccer analog of orchestrator.code's 'a company with N repos'). Installs into the club's umbrella repo and owns the club's OPERATIONAL DATA in state/ — a relational model of 13 concerns: members (players/parents), staff (coaches/directors/admins/board), teams, rosters, try-outs, leagues, tournaments, fields, complexes, schedules, multi-system registrations, + the age-group/gender/registration-system dimensions. The role-DOMAINS (domain.soccer.{player,coach,parent,director,board,team,league} + the live goalkeeping) give each PERSON their role toolkit — SOFT references (no requires.elements[]); the orchestrator manages people/units/events, the domains are the playbooks. v0.1.0 FOUNDATION: the entity-model spine + People/Org/Process skills (member/staff/team/roster/tryout) + status; the 6 phase-2 concerns (field/complex/schedule/tournament/league/registration) are DEFINED in the model + have state/ dirs, their skills land in phase 2.
rasa.naming: First sub-namespaced ORCHESTRATOR (extends the domain.soccer.goalkeeping sub-namespace precedent to the orchestrator kind). Dotted name rasa.orchestrator.soccer.club; folder/repo dashed (orchestrator-soccer-club); rasa.json#name authoritative; alias rasa.orchestrator.soccer-club.

references.role_family: domain.soccer.{player,coach,parent,director,board,team,league} (+ goalkeeping) — the per-role toolkits the managed people use; soft references, graceful if absent (only goalkeeping is content-bearing so far)
references.sibling: orchestrator.code (the engineering Pattern-3 sibling — same shape, different vertical)

element.description: Element-owned club-ops toolkit, refreshed on upgrade. Installs into the club's umbrella repo: the club-ops rules spine + skills to .claude/, the entity-record templates + the data-model README to state/. The actual records + the club config are project-owned (see seed.files).

files.note: The club-ops spine + THE ENTITY MODEL for all 13 concerns (canonical field sets, relationships, invariants, the foundation-vs-phase-2 split). Every skill executes this contract.

The foundation club-ops skills: /member, /staff, /team, /roster, /tryout, /status. Phase-2 skills (field/complex/schedule/tournament/league/registration) land later. Element-owned; refreshed on upgrade.
The state/ data-model reference: one dir per entity, one .md per record from its _template, the foundation-vs-phase-2 split. Element-owned.
Member record shape (player|parent). /member creates records from it.
Staff record shape (coach|director|admin|board). /staff creates records from it.
Team record shape (age_group x gender x season). /team creates records from it.
Roster record shape. /roster creates records from it (keeping the team + member surfaces consistent).
Try-out record shape. /tryout creates records from it; outcomes feed /roster.
Orchestrator overview + install map. Authoring doc; not installed into the club repo.

seed.description: Project-owned club state copied at install only (skip-if-exists). These belong to the club's umbrella repo: the club config (dimensions) + the per-entity record dirs. Records are created by the skills, not seeded; the dirs exist from install so the full 13-concern model is present.

files.note: The club PROFILE + the cross-cutting DIMENSIONS the whole platform reads: age_groups, genders, registration_systems, seasons. Project-owned; the director fills it. Every skill resolves dimensions here.
Phase-2 entity dir (League records). Scaffolded so the full model is present; the /league skill + _template land in phase 2.
Phase-2 entity dir (Complex records — fields, parking, vending).
Phase-2 entity dir (Schedule records — practice/game; team x field x datetime).
Phase-2 entity dir (Registration records — member/team x system x season).
Per-project Claude session contract for the club's umbrella repo. Project-owned.
Connection Contract lockfile (canon Spec §6). Stamped with the Element HEAD SHA at init.
